definition.def: A dramatic change or event happens suddenly and is very noticeable and surprising.
examples: Changes in sea level could have a dramatic effect.
This policy has led to a dramatic increase in our prison populations.

definition.def: A dramatic action, event, or situation is exciting and impressive.
examples: He witnessed many dramatic escapes as people jumped from as high as the fourth floor.
Their arrival was dramatic and exciting.

definition.def: You use dramatic to describe things connected with or relating to the theatre, drama, or plays.
examples: I had no thoughts of making a dramatic film. I was working in documentary.
